messages:
arjun: Heads-up — dashboard spiking with route-debounce alerts for /v1/generate. Seeing lots of short re-routes around SA token rotations, token attribution jumps. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: Yea I noticed the noise. Current debounce is 100ms which seems low for our SA-affinity flows. Some clients rotate tokens every ~30s which amplifies churn.

derek: Do we have per-tenant heatmap? want to know if it's concentrated or wide. also worried about quota misattribution when reroutes happen.

lina: Pasted a small log sample from staging (trimmed):
```
2025-04-06T15:37:02Z route=/v1/generate token=sa-1234 debounce_ms=100 fallback=zone-b
2025-04-06T15:37:02Z route=/v1/generate token=sa-1234 route_change=route-983 reason=token_rotation
```
Shows immediate reroute on token exchange.

sam: If we bump to 500ms we might reduce re-routes but could hurt p99 for genuine cross-region fallbacks. Prefer dynamic debounce: ephemeral tokens get long debounce, permanent tokens short.

maria: Dynamic makes sense. UX ask: add console control to override debounce per-routing-policy and a telemetry label like `debounce_override` so we can track rollouts.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary: applied routing-config v2025.04.06-rc3 to staging — debounce_ms still 100 for now. See /deploy/2025.04.06-rc3

arjun: Proposed plan: A/B for 2 weeks. Implement dynamic-debounce for ephemeral tokens in routing layer + add dashboard panels: `debounce_hits`, `token_affinity_misses`, and sampling for `token.type`. Derek/maria — can you own telemetry labels? Lina — can you add more sample logs to staging?

derek: I'll own telemetry. Will add tags: `route.debounce_ms`, `token.type`, `token.rotation_window`, `quota.attribution` and emit counters for `debounce_trigger` and `debounce_suppressed`. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria: I'll mock the console control: per-route override that by default inherits global policy. Put Figma link: https://figma.com/file/xyz/debounce-control (WIP) :thumbsup:

lina: Logs uploaded to staging at https://staging-logs/redwood/1765432222. Noted another pattern: token-exchange latency >200ms tends to trigger immediate reroute path.

sam: I'll run latency simulations + perf tests. If p99 spikes >5% with dynamic-debounce, we'll revert.

arjun: Great. Filed follow-up issue #1234 to track rollout and dashboard panels. Let's sync 9:30am tomorrow to review telemetry samples. Thanks everyone :rocket:
